build_aria_conditional_generation: build an AriaForConditionalGeneration model for multimodal image and text generation tasks
create_aria_model: create an AriaModel that combines a vision tower with a language model for multimodal understanding
create_aria_text_model: create an AriaTextModel with MoE architecture for autoregressive text generation
create_aria_projector: create an AriaProjector that projects vision features into the language model embedding space
create_aria_cross_attention: create an AriaCrossAttention module for cross-attention between vision and text features
